records.title: Binance Security Incident Update
records.note: Binance estimates total impact around $6.3B and says about $3B frozen on-chain. It says initial investigation suggests a compromised DevOps engineer laptop/service container enabled unauthorized withdrawal transactions; no evidence of wallet private-key leak. Binance says it will cover losses with SAFU and company funds, temporarily suspended deposits/withdrawals, revoked affected address authorization and will publish updated proof of reserves after remediation. This is Binance's statement, not an independent loss audit.

records.title: TRM Labs: North Korea Steals USD 6.36 Billion From Binance
records.note: TRM says approximately $6.36B moved from Binance-attributed wallets across ten chains; it attributes the operation to TraderTraitor with high confidence. Its on-chain trace reports 233.46M native XRP from five Binance XRPL wallets between 20:05–20:09 UTC on Oct 29, remaining at the attacker address as of TRM's 2026-10-30 00:30 UTC cutoff; 88.5M RLUSD moved on Ethereum, 48M sold via DEXs and 40.5M frozen by Ripple; Ripple also froze RLUSD in the compromised Binance hot wallet. TRM reports approximately 1.77B USDT, 825M USDC, 27.8M USD1 and Arbitrum Security Council action. TRM reports about 325M USDT sold to market makers/solvers for 122,300 ETH at a discount exceeding 10%, 60M USDT supplied to Aave against 19,760 ETH borrowed, and 300M USDT supplied to JustLend. TRM's on-chain trace and attribution are provider claims, not Binance's completed postmortem.

records.title: Reuters: TRM says North Korea behind Binance crypto theft
records.note: Reuters reports TRM's high-confidence attribution to TraderTraitor and its approximately $6.36B cross-chain movement estimate. This is corroboration that Reuters reported TRM's assessment, not an independent second on-chain measurement of the 233.46M XRP.

records.title: AP: Binance investigates security incident with estimated $6.3B impact
records.note: AP distinguishes Binance's estimated impact from a confirmed final theft total. It reports Binance's suspected compromised DevOps laptop/service-container path, no evidence of wallet private-key leakage, user-funds assurance, temporary suspension and roughly $3B frozen. AP does not independently establish the XRP wallet transfers.

records.title: CoinDesk: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets
records.note: CoinDesk's review says Binance 14 appeared in the Oct 1 proof-of-reserves wallet list and that its ETH backing could fall below 100% until replenished; it also discusses USDC and other assets. The article does not establish that the five XRPL wallets holding the 233.46M XRP were in the PoR set. It says Binance's next reserve snapshot is expected Nov 1. Do not extrapolate its ETH reserve calculation to XRP.

records.title: Binance Proof of Reserves methodology and scope
records.note: Binance says PoR concerns assets held in custody for users and uses wallet ownership checks, customer balance snapshots, Merkle trees and zk-SNARKs. The live page does not expose the Oct 1 XRP address-to-liability crosswalk in the text retrieved this run.

records.title: TokenPost: Binance Oct 1 reserves show XRP ratio 100.77%
records.note: Secondary report of Binance's Oct 1 PoR lists XRP reserve ratio 100.77%. This is a stale pre-incident snapshot. Exact wallet crosswalk to the five XRP wallets in TRM's incident trace is not established; do not calculate current XRP coverage from this ratio.

records.title: XRP Insights: labeled XRP exchange wallet balances
records.note: Reports 22.58B XRP across 701 labeled wallets at 24 exchanges, 32.9% of its 68.59B circulating-supply denominator; Upbit 6.42B, Coinbase 5.84B, Binance 2.80B. The dataset includes cold storage and some reserve wallets; 38.4% of tracked balances lack hot/cold labels, and newly labeled wallets can distort same-wallet changes. These are exchange-attributed wallet balances, not proprietary exchange holdings or customer liabilities.

Its cross-asset ETF overview separately reports XRP 30-day inflow $19.3M, an internal cross-view discrepancy requiring universe/window reconciliation. Not issuer-level settlement confirmation.

records.title: DefiLlama XRPL chain metrics
records.note: At capture: DeFi TVL $309.6M (-7.96% 24h); stablecoin market cap $1.082B (+4.86% 7d); RLUSD dominance 91.58%; RWA active AUM $21.95M; DEX volume $4.2M 24h and $29.16M 7d (-24.86%); 48,537 active addresses, 4,737 new addresses and 4.41M transactions. TVL, stablecoin supply, DEX volume and address/transaction counters are different measures and not direct XRP demand.

records.title: CoinDesk Q2 2026 XRPL activity and tokenized-asset analysis
records.note: Reports Q2 order-book trading +79% y/y while accounts initiating trades fell about 41%; daily active accounts averaged 16,600 (-24% y/y), new accounts 2,800 (-25%); order-book share of DEX trading 81% versus 54% a year earlier; DEX volume 4.42M XRP/day; tokenized assets averaged $3.72B and RLUSD balances $539M, about $4.26B combined. Some figures are attributed to Evernorth quarterly data; accounts are not persons. Historical Q2 context, not current live activity.

records.title: Reuters: Yen gains after BOJ hold; AI jitters drive Treasury rally
records.note: BOJ held policy rate at 1.25% but raised its inflation forecast and retained a hawkish tightening bias; yen reached 157.115/USD; US 10-year yield 4.8958%, 30-year 5.2623%, dollar index 101.77, Brent on track for an 11.5% monthly rise. Reuters attributes Treasury bid and softer USD partly to AI-spending concerns; macro context only, not XRP causality.

records.title: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation: Generative AI seminar
records.note: Official SBIC East Japan event page identifies a free Zoom seminar titled 'Current and Future of Generative AI', 15:00–17:00 JST, with a Microsoft Japan executive evangelist as speaker. The description mentions ChatGPT's emergence in Nov 2022 as context; this is an educational seminar, not evidence of an OpenAI partnership, SBI Holdings affiliation or XRP investment.

records.note: Previously captured Oct 26 dashboard values: approximately $71.0B USDC circulation and $71.2B reserves, with circulation down approximately $4.2B over 30 days. Global issuer totals do not identify XRPL-specific supply or Binance-related flows.

records.title: Coinbase public status page
records.note: Status page showed no incidents reported for Oct 29 in its incident history. This is not proof of zero customer impact or evidence of post-Binance-hack deposit inflows.

records.title: Reuters: analysts react to Binance security breach
records.note: Reuters reports Coinbase shares fell 4.8% in extended trading as the breach affected crypto-market sentiment. Share-price reaction is not evidence Coinbase was compromised or that users moved XRP to Coinbase.
